author: sebastienb311

title: Fantastic guide who brings history to life with enthusiasm and humor
text: What a nice tour of a special place. Interesting, with humor, a lot of information without being overwhelmed with dates. No history lesson, but through stories our guide Kiko took us back in time. Their love and enthusiasm for the Alhambra and Granada is beautiful to see. We will not remember all the legends, but for anyone going to the Alhambra, it is a must-see.
author: saskiakesselaervanw
